project_description: Build an AI application that allows users to upload documents and ask questions using Retrieval Augmented Generation.
Build a conversational AI application using an LLM with conversation history and prompt engineering.
Build a semantic job search system that matches resumes and job descriptions using embeddings.
Build an AI system that extracts skills from resumes and provides career recommendations.
Build a machine learning system that predicts whether customers may leave a service.
Build a regression model that predicts house prices from property features.
Build an image classification application using a convolutional neural network.
Build a real-time object detection system using YOLO and OpenCV.
Build an NLP application that classifies text sentiment.
Build and deploy a machine learning model through a production-style REST API.
Build a semantic search engine that finds relevant documents using embeddings and vector search.
Build an AI research assistant that searches multiple documents and generates grounded answers.
Build an AI system that recommends career roles based on skills, gaps and job requirements.
Build a computer vision system that detects vehicles and supports intelligent traffic management.
Build a question-answering assistant over a structured knowledge base using semantic retrieval.
